slides.title: Every row turns into a race.
slides.body: Easy days drift hard. Hard days end up not hard enough.

slides.title: Easy builds the engine.
slides.body: Low intensity grows your aerobic base. Only if it's easy.

slides.title: Talk in full sentences.
slides.body: Can't? Slow down. Breathing through your nose is a good check.

slides.title: Then go hard on hard days.
slides.body: Fresh legs make intervals hurt the way they should.
